population.entity.value: final packaging combination, i.e. a packaging item that is not a component (contains_id) of any other packaging
population.entity.rationale: The question asks for averages across 'final packaging combinations'; no business definition exists, so the most literal reading is the top-level/outermost packaging items (roots of the packaging hierarchy).

population.eligibility.value: Include only final/outermost packaging items (those never appearing as contains_id). Each such combination is fully expanded; only its leaf-level items contribute quantity.
population.eligibility.rationale: No business definition found; literal reading of 'final packaging combinations' and 'leaf-level items within each combination'.

population.joinMultiplicity.value: packaging_relations is a self-referencing parent->child hierarchy. Recursive expansion yields possibly multiple leaf rows per combination (and the same leaf type may recur via different paths); quantity must be multiplied along the path, not deduplicated.
population.joinMultiplicity.rationale: Physical structure of packaging_relations (self FK) observed in schema.

of.per: leaf-level item occurrence within a combination
of.of: expanded leaf quantity (qty multiplied along the containment path)

measure.countGrain.value: per final packaging combination (entity); denominator is the number of final packaging combinations
measure.countGrain.rationale: The average is taken across combinations.

measure.denominator.value: number of final packaging combinations (root packaging items); no zero-denominator case expected
measure.denominator.rationale: Average across all final packaging combinations.
